title: Writing Linear Equations: Slope-Intercept, Point-Slope and Standard Form
seo_title: Algebra I Writing Linear Equations Worksheets (TEKS A.2B, A.2C)
standard_text: A.2B write linear equations in two variables in various forms, including y = mx + b, Ax + By = C, and y − y1 = m(x − x1), given one point and the slope and given two points; A.2C write linear equations in two variables given a table of values, a graph, and a verbal description
meta_desc: Free Algebra I worksheets for Texas TEKS A.2B and A.2C: write linear equations in slope-intercept, point-slope and standard form from points, tables and words. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Find the slope, then use a point.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Slope-intercept: y = mx + b. Find m, then put a point in to find b.
  • Point-slope: y − y1 = m(x − x1).
  • Standard: Ax + By = C. Solve for y to get slope-intercept form.

Examples

Example

Through (2, 7) with slope 3

7 = 3(2) + b

b = 1

Answer: y = 3x + 1

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using the point's x as bb is where x = 0.
Wrong sign in point-slope formThrough (2, −5): y + 5 = m(x − 2).
Dividing only one termDivide every term by B.

Point-slope when you know a point and slope; slope-intercept for graphing.

items.q: A gym had 120 members in month 1 and 180 members in month 4. Write a point-slope equation using the point (1, 120).
What is the equation of the horizontal line through (4, −2)?
items.e: A horizontal line has slope 0, so every point has y = −2: y = −2.

items.q: A water tank holds 500 gallons and drains at 20 gallons per minute. Which equation gives the water W after t minutes?
items.e: Start at 500 and lose 20 each minute: W = −20t + 500.

items.q: Adult tickets cost $8 and child tickets cost $5. A school spends $400. Which standard-form equation models this?
items.e: Cost of adults plus cost of children equals the total: 8a + 5c = 400.

items.q: A line has point-slope equation y + 3 = 2(x − 5). Which point is on the line?
items.e: y − y1 = m(x − x1) with y + 3 = y − (−3): the point is (5, −3).

items.q: Which line is parallel to y = 4x − 7?
items.e: Same slope (4), different intercept: y = 4x + 2.

items.q: For 8a + 5c = 400, what does the a-intercept 50 mean?
c: The school can buy 50 adult tickets and no child tickets
items.e: The a-intercept is where c = 0: 50 adult tickets and no child tickets.

items.q: Write y + 3 = 2(x − 5) in slope-intercept form.
items.e: Distribute: y + 3 = 2x − 10, then subtract 3: y = 2x − 13.

items.q: A taxi ride costs $3.50 plus $2.25 per mile. Which equation in slope-intercept form gives the cost C for m miles?
items.e: The rate per mile is the slope and the starting fee is the y-intercept: C = 2.25m + 3.50.

items.q: Which line is perpendicular to y = 2x + 1?
items.e: The negative reciprocal of 2 is −½: y = −½x + 3.

items.q: Which describes the graph of height over time?
c: It stays the same the whole time
It goes up the whole time
It goes up, stays the same, then goes down
It goes down, stays the same, then goes up
items.e: Read from left to right. It goes up, stays the same, then goes down. The answer is it goes up, stays the same, then goes down.

items.q: A function is increasing. What happens to y as x gets bigger?
items.e: Increasing means y gets bigger as x gets bigger.

items.q: Which describes the graph of water over time?
c: It goes down the whole time
It stays the same, then goes down
It goes up, then stays the same
It goes down, then stays the same
items.e: Read from left to right. It goes down, then stays the same. The answer is it goes down, then stays the same.

items.q: On a graph of distance over time, what does a flat part mean?
items.e: Distance does not change, so the person is not moving.

items.q: Which describes the graph of distance over time?
c: It goes up, stays the same, then goes up again
It goes up the whole time at the same speed
It goes up, then down, then up
items.e: Read from left to right. It goes up, stays the same, then goes up again. The answer is it goes up, stays the same, then goes up again.

items.q: A linear function has slope −2. Is it increasing or decreasing?
items.e: A negative slope means y goes down as x goes up: decreasing.

items.q: Mia walks to school, stops to talk to a friend, then runs the rest of the way. Which graph shape fits distance from home?
c: Up, flat, then up more steeply
items.e: Walking: going up. Stopping: flat. Running: going up faster (steeper). Up, flat, then up more steeply.

items.q: On a graph of distance from home over time, what does a part going down mean?
items.e: Distance from home gets smaller: going back toward home.

items.q: Which describes the graph of speed over time?
c: It stays the same the whole time
items.e: Read from left to right. It stays the same the whole time. The answer is it stays the same the whole time.

items.q: A linear function has slope 0. What does its graph look like?
items.e: Slope 0 means y never changes: a horizontal line.
